items.control_name: Enforce OAuth2 / OpenID Connect Authorization on Azure API Management (APIM)
items.description: APIM policies must validate OAuth2 access tokens or OpenID Connect signatures before forwarding traffic to backend APIs.
items.current_value: 100% of APIM APIs enforce 'validate-jwt' policy with Entra ID tenant validation
items.recommended_value: Mandatory OAuth2/JWT validation policy applied at global APIM scope
items.remediation_notes: Ensure APIM rate-limit and quota-by-key policies are active.

items.control_name: Enforce Automated Rotation & Expiration Dates on Key Vault Secrets
items.description: All Key Vault secrets and certificates must define an expiration date and use Azure Event Grid automation for 90-day rotation.
items.current_value: 15 secrets have expiration date; 3 secrets lack expiration date or rotation
items.recommended_value: 100% of secrets set expiration date and rotation policy
items.remediation_notes: Set expiration dates on legacy secrets in 'kv-app-core'.

items.control_name: Enable Defender for Containers Vulnerability Scanning on Azure Container Registry (ACR)
items.description: ACR registries must have Defender for Containers enabled to scan container images for vulnerabilities upon push and continuously.
items.current_value: Defender for Containers active on 'acrprodregistry01'; 0 critical CVEs found
items.recommended_value: Defender for Containers enabled across 100% of ACR instances
items.remediation_notes: Integrate scan results into Azure DevOps build gates.

items.control_name: Enforce VNet Integration and Private Endpoints on Azure App Services
items.description: App Services and Functions must enable VNet Integration for outbound traffic and disable public network access in favor of Private Endpoints.
items.current_value: 12 App Services use Private Endpoints; 2 Dev apps exposed on public IPs
items.recommended_value: 100% Private Endpoints; Public Network Access = Disabled
